data.credibility: Management demonstrates solid reliability by successfully delivering or raising guidance targets. However, they occasionally stop mentioning strategic initiatives or fail to follow up on multi-year targets like AI native services, indicating minor topic drops.

lines.line: Promised 4%-5% services growth, raised in Q3, and delivered 4.8% in Q4 FY26.
Promised 3%-5% company growth, raised in Q3, and delivered 3.9% in Q4 FY26.
Promised 17%-18% EBIT margin, reiterated in Q3, and delivered 17.2% in Q4 FY26.
Guided FY27 revenue growth of 1%-4%, reiterated and raised through Q2 FY27.
Guided FY27 services revenue growth of 1.5%-4.5%, raised in Q2 FY27.
Guided FY27 EBIT margin of 17.5%-18.5%, reporting 18.2% in Q2 FY27.
Targeted 25%-30% AI native services growth over 5 years, but left unmentioned.
Proposed INR3,500 crores AI datacenter investment, pending further long-term updates.
